Cookie Policy

# Cookie Policy

This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, the types of cookies we use (i.e., the information we collect using cookies and how that information is used), and how to manage your cookie settings.

### What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files used to store small pieces of information. They are stored on your device when a website loads in your browser. These files help ensure proper website functionality, enhance security, provide a better user experience, and analyze performance to identify improvements.

### How do we use cookies?

Our website uses both first-party and third-party cookies. First-party cookies are primarily necessary for the website to function properly and do not collect any personally identifiable data.

Third-party cookies help us understand website performance, track user interactions, maintain security, deliver relevant advertisements, and enhance user experience while improving speed for future interactions.

### Types of cookies we use

#### Necessary

Necessary cookies help the website function properly and support essential security and consent features. These cookies do not require consent.

| Cookie | Duration | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| \_\_cf\_bm | 1 hour | This cookie supports Cloudflare Bot Management by managing incoming traffic that matches criteria associated with bots. |

#### Preferences

Preference cookies remember optional choices and settings made by visitors to improve their experience.

| Cookie | Duration | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `li_gc` | 6 months | Stores the visitor’s consent preference regarding non-essential LinkedIn cookies. |
| `lidc` | 1 day | LinkedIn uses this cookie to facilitate data-centre selection. |

#### Analytics

Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors arrive at and use the website, allowing us to measure and improve website performance.

| Cookie | Duration | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `_ga_*` | 1 year 1 month 4 days | Google Analytics uses this cookie to store and count page views. |
| `_ga` | 1 year 1 month 4 days | Google Analytics uses this cookie to calculate visitor, session, and campaign data, track website usage, and distinguish visitors using an anonymously generated identifier. |
| `__hstc` | 6 months | HubSpot uses this cookie to track visitors. It records the domain, first visit, most recent visit, current visit, and session number. |
| `hubspotutk` | 6 months | HubSpot uses this cookie to recognise website visitors. It may be passed to HubSpot when a form is submitted and used to deduplicate contacts. |
| `__hssrc` | Session | HubSpot uses this cookie to determine whether the visitor has restarted their browser and to identify a new session. |
| `__hssc` | 1 hour | HubSpot uses this cookie to track sessions, page views, and session start time. It helps update the session number and timestamps stored in the `__hstc` cookie. |

#### Marketing

Marketing cookies help measure advertising activity and attribute visits or enquiries to advertising campaigns.

| Cookie | Duration | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `_gcl_au` | 3 months | Google uses this cookie to measure and improve advertising efficiency. |
| `bcookie` | 1 year | LinkedIn uses this cookie through LinkedIn share buttons and advertising tags to recognise browser IDs. |
| `_fbp` | 3 months | Facebook uses this cookie to store and track website interactions for advertising measurement. |

# Manage cookie preferences

### Consent Preferences

You can modify your cookie settings at any time by selecting Cookie Settings in the footer. This allows you to revisit the cookie consent banner and update your preferences or withdraw your consent immediately.

This will allow you to revisit the cookie consent banner and update your preferences or withdraw your consent immediately.

Additionally, different browsers offer various methods to block or delete cookies used by websites. You can adjust your browser settings to block or delete cookies. Below are links to support documents on how to manage and delete cookies in major web browsers.

- [Chrome](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/32050)

- [Safari](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/safari/sfri11471/mac)

- [Firefox](https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/clear-cookies-and-site-data-firefox?redirectslug=delete-cookies-remove-info-websites-stored&redirectlocale=en-US)

- [Internet Explorer](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/topic/how-to-delete-cookie-files-in-internet-explorer-bca9446f-d873-78de-77ba-d42645fa52fc)


If you are using a different web browser, please refer to its official support documentation.
